description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that implements a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with external services like OpenAI and a vector store for retrieving relevant textbook content to answer user questions.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing local vector storage and search operations for document chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: A class for asynchronous interaction with OpenAI's API.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs embedding, search, and generates a context-aware answer using OpenAI's chat completion API.
